title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Open Weight Models & AI Agent Benchmarks: Meta opens weights for its 30B dense model Muse Glimmer while developers document autonomous AI coding agents performing complete Python-to-Rust library refactors.

Autonomous Aviation & AI Infrastructure: Archer Aviation executes major strategic acquisitions of Wisk Aero and Insitu from Boeing, integrating autonomous flight control systems into its Zee foundation AI stack.

Geopolitics & Energy Corridor Dynamics: Macro political developments see Iranian officials outline long-term standoff strategies regarding US diplomatic negotiations and Strait of Hormuz maritime routes.
Enterprise Hardware & Server Market Forecasts: Semiconductor forecasts project the global server CPU market to surpass $200 billion by 2030 driven by sustained AI cluster deployments.
Sports Trading & Prediction Markets: Prediction markets highlight shifting Ballon d'Or odds alongside high-profile ownership moves in European football.

items.title: @finkd: Meta Releases Open Weights for 30B Muse Glimmer Model
items.body: Meta opens the weights for Muse Glimmer, a 30-billion parameter dense model designed for local deployment, while teasing the upcoming release of its flagship foundation model Muse Spark 1.2.

items.title: @dhh: AI Code Agent Executes Complete Python-to-Rust Library Rewrite
items.body: David Heinemeier Hansson shares how autonomous AI coder Fable rewrote Python's TerminalTextEffects library into Rust, cutting startup latency from 87ms down to 2ms and achieving a 9.6x increase in rendering throughput.

items.title: @Adidotdev: OpenAI Pre-train Details Surface for Next-Gen Model Astra
items.body: Leaked benchmark details suggest OpenAI's upcoming model Astra was trained on a 10-trillion token pre-training dataset codenamed 'doug', doubling the dataset scale of Sol and demonstrating major leaps in reasoning and text quality.

items.title: @kimmonismus: OpenAI vs. Anthropic Engineer Code Bench Escalation
items.body: Inside rivalry between OpenAI and Anthropic engineers escalates as developers showcase competing benchmarks and harness tests comparing GPT-5.6 Sol against Anthropic's Fable environment.

items.title: @flyarcher: Archer Acquires Wisk, SkyGrid, and Insitu to Build Autonomous Aviation Stack
items.body: Archer Aviation announces major strategic acquisitions from Boeing—including autonomous aircraft developer Wisk and drone manufacturer Insitu—combining autonomous flight tech with its Zee foundation AI model for next-generation aerospace.

items.title: @composio: Benchmarking DeepSeek V4 Flash Across Agentic Frameworks
items.body: Composio evaluates DeepSeek V4 Flash across 30 multi-step agentic tasks using 4 distinct execution harnesses, finding Pi Agent to be both the most cost-effective and highest-performing framework.

items.title: @HormuzReport: Geopolitical Standoff Extends Strait of Hormuz Timeline
items.body: Iranian officials formally reject diplomatic negotiations with the US administration, outlining a strategy of ambiguity and patience while maintaining demands for asset releases and military withdrawals.

items.title: @YahooFinance: AMD Projects $200B Server CPU Market by 2030
items.body: Yahoo Finance highlights AMD executive forecasts pointing to massive expansion in data center compute demand, projecting the global server CPU TAM to exceed $200 billion before the end of the decade.

items.title: @Novig: US Nationwide Launch of Sports Prediction Exchange
items.body: Novig officially launches nationwide in the US, providing sports trading enthusiasts with a commission-free prediction market exchange platform.

items.title: @KalshiFC: Harry Kane Leads Ballon d'Or Odds on Prediction Markets
items.body: Kalshi prediction market probability data shows Harry Kane surging to a 59% favorite for the upcoming Ballon d'Or, outpacing Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappé.

items.title: @WinsLFC: Jeff Bezos Explores Major Investment in Football Ownership
items.body: Reports detail Jeff Bezos acquiring a 30%+ stake in Liverpool FC with ambitious plans to support major squad transfers and expansion.

items.title: @Deltissd24: Viral Hollywood Retrospective of Dakota Fanning's First Award
items.body: A nostalgic film clip resurfaces showing seven-year-old Dakota Fanning receiving her first major acting award for 'I Am Sam', standing on a stool while presenter Orlando Bloom held her at the microphone.

items.title: @muellerberndt: Open Proof Project Uses Lean 4 for Spacetime & Quantum Physics
items.body: Bernhard Mueller launches OPH, an open auditable initiative inviting physics and formal logic contributors to verify Lean 4 proofs modeling observer constraints on spacetime and quantum mechanics.

items.title: @fw_kulture: Cinema Craft Comparison of 35MM vs. IMAX Formats
